decision: Keep the fixed ECMAScript 2026 rejection: inherited +Await does not permit await as a bare IdentifierReference. Node v24.12.0 accepts some instance-field cases but rejects static-field counterparts; Node is a secondary oracle, not the normative target.
nodeAcceptedExample: async function f(value = class { field = await; }) {}
nodeRejectedCounterpart: async function f(value = class { static field = await; }) {}
stagingStatus: esid: pending; excluded from the standard corpus
evidence: context-results.jsonl.failures.jsonl (10 unexpected rejections against Node-derived expectations)
correction: The initial audit interpretation that FieldDefinition resets ~Await was incorrect; the official 2026 grammar explicitly inherits ?Await. No product change retained.
